what_happened: Dispatch hypothesis confirmed on first pass: the open-future/open-past restriction in report 03's (P, x) encoding reduces to a first-order condition over directed reachability, so no new MSO machinery is needed. Grep confirmed report 03 never mentions the open modals, so the contribution is genuinely new.

Two pre-existing gaps found in report 03 section 1.3 while checking it against the open modals: step 1's per-state witness economy is unsound for any modal whose witness depends on more than the present state (and its induction needs witnesses at every walk of the sub-digraph, not only the designated countable set), and step 3 produces a FOREST of countably many trees while step 5 applies Rabin to a single tree, with no stated new-root coding. Neither is introduced by the open modals; both are recorded in this task's report rather than patched.

Research report was complete and self-consistent enough that planning reduced to propagation only: three findings to push into report 03 section 1.3 and one filing-ready R1 proposal. No research round needed, no plan-time re-derivation, plan validated PASS with 0 warnings on first authoring.

Both of this plan's file targets are shared-contention risks with siblings dispatched the same cycle with undeclared file_scope: task 864's stated job is porting the LC schema out of 559's probe directory (Phase 1's target tree) before archival, and task 868 (L-plus-plus-open transfer corollaries) is a likely specs/ROADMAP.md editor (Phase 2's target). Recorded in the plan's Risks table with re-read-immediately-before-edit and explicit-file-list staging as the mitigation.

Three-phase propagation plan executed with zero deviations: report 03 section 1.3 amended additively (53 lines, validate-artifact.sh green), specs/ROADMAP.md verdict/867-annotation/R1/R2 recorded additively with the coverage-appendix marker and run-order section untouched, and both artifact-level checks passed on first attempt.

Phase 3's Batch Gate Deferral directive asked for a scoped narrowing invocation (run-all.sh --only SUITE or verify-deploy.sh --only-gate N) covering this phase's touched files. suite_selection_select specs/ROADMAP.md specs/559_.../reports/03_axiomatizability-rules-engine.md returned __FULL_SWEEP__: no suite or gate covers specs/** markdown content specifically, consistent with the plan's own risk-table statement (gate 3 doc-lint has no bearing, gate 4 task-reference lint is exempt by design for specs/**). Deferred the full gate sweep to the batch-level stage as the directive allows; validate-artifact.sh (the actually-applicable check for both touched reports) was run directly and passed.
